text: The write guard is a mitmproxy per browser, not JavaScript in the page: page code, service workers, beacons and frames cannot route around it. Keep safety decisions in guard/policy.py, never in the agent prompt. adr/0001-network-write-guard.md.
Severity, classification and the gate come from rules over recorded evidence, never from a model. A single persona's report is capped at major unless corroborated. adr/0002-deterministic-judge.md.

Journeys are selected from the diff by ownership globs; the model may only add journeys for unclaimed files, never remove one. A PR that touches no journey runs nothing. adr/0003-diff-aware-journey-selection.md.
Screenshots are committed to report.images_repo in one commit per run and linked by commit SHA, so a later run never changes an earlier comment's pictures. adr/0004-screenshots-in-images-repo.md.
PR comments and issues can be posted as a GitHub App with a per-repository installation token, signed with the openssl CLI so the package has no crypto dependency. adr/0005-github-app-posting.md.

Agent finding fingerprints are built only from the sources' (journey, page, category), never from model-written titles, so they are stable across runs and merge orders. adr/0006-stable-fingerprints.md.
Tests run on AWS CodeBuild through deploy/aws/test.sh (or locally); the repository has no GitHub Actions workflow of its own. adr/0007-tests-on-codebuild.md.
Possible fixes are off unless report.suggest_fixes is set: they send PR diff text to the model. They never fail a run and are labelled unverified. adr/0008-possible-fixes-opt-in.md.

The MCP server wraps the CLI with a SWARM_PERSONA_CONFIGS allowlist, a private auth.log, generic config errors, a two-run cap under a file lock, and SIGTERM then SIGKILL to the run's process group. adr/0009-mcp-server-safety.md.
